name: Event Date Poll
author: setthedate

sections.description:
Set The Date helps groups easily agree on a date for events. This plugin adds a lightweight, mobile-friendly call-to-action widget to your WordPress sidebar, linking directly to the scheduling app at https://setthedate.app.

Use it for:
– Airbnb or short-term rental hosts
– Event planners and community organizers
– Social clubs, families, and friends

Features:
– Customizable heading and CTA text
– Clean, responsive layout
– Privacy-friendly: no tracking, cookies, or scripts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Widgets and drag the Set The Date Widget into your sidebar.
  4. Customize the title and CTA text as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin track users?

No. This plugin includes no tracking, cookies, or scripts. It is privacy-respecting by design.

Can I change the button link?

No. The widget is designed to always link to https://setthedate.app to keep things consistent for users.

Will this support Gutenberg or blocks?

Not yet. This version is widget-only. A block version may be released in the future.
